entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Prashant Jain - Ga for the State.
Shri Gagan Parashar- Advocate for the objector.
Heard on the question of admission.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing.

Also heard on I.A.No.14750/2025 which is application under Section 430 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence on behalf of the appellant- Sunny@Sani.
2.

Appellant has been convicted under sections 450, 323 and 376 of the IPC and sentenced for 5 years RI with fine of Rs. 1,000/-, 6 months R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/- and 10 years RI with fine of Rs. 1,000/- with default stipulations vide judgment dated 29.09.2025 in ST No.179/2022 by the 1st Additional Sessions Judge, District Dhar (MP).
3.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that victim has no objection if appellant is enlarged on bail.
There is no possibility of final hearing of the appeal in near future.

Therefore, if the jail sentence is not suspended, the purpose of filing this appeal would become futile.
4.
Counsel for the victim submits that victim has no objection if 2 CRA-10195-2025 appellant is granted suspension to the appellant.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer.

6. Considering the statement of victim who has been examined as PW- 3 along with the report of Forensic Science Laboratory, Indore (Exhibit- P/16) and the fact that final hearing of the appeal will take sufficient long time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, the appellant shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 03.08.2026 and on such Sunny @ Sani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142112277/
